prompt: Three changes, and nothing else: (1) members get 15% off instead of 10%; staff keep 10%. (2) Rename the promotion SUMMER-21 to SUMMER-22 everywhere it appears in src/pricing/rules.ts. (3) In "src/legacy config/limits.ts", raise MAX_ITEMS from 50 to 100; MAX_BATCHES stays 50.

check.name: rules.ts is exactly right
check.run: cmp -s src/pricing/rules.ts "$EVAL_TASK_DIR/hidden/expected/src/pricing/rules.ts" || { git diff --stat HEAD -- src/pricing/rules.ts; diff "$EVAL_TASK_DIR/hidden/expected/src/pricing/rules.ts" src/pricing/rules.ts | head -20; exit 1; }

check.name: limits.ts is exactly right
check.run: cmp -s "src/legacy config/limits.ts" "$EVAL_TASK_DIR/hidden/expected/src/legacy config/limits.ts" || { diff "$EVAL_TASK_DIR/hidden/expected/src/legacy config/limits.ts" "src/legacy config/limits.ts"; exit 1; }

diag.skill: Precise tool use: a 2,400-line file with tabs (past the 2,000-line read limit), an oldString that matches twice, an occurrence only a search or an offset read finds, and a path with a space.
diag.trap: Editing staffPrice too (the same line twice), missing the SUMMER-21 at line 2,300, rewriting the big file with write and changing its tabs, raising MAX_BATCHES, or failing to quote the path with a space.
